{"version":3,"file":"index.js","names":["greeting"],"sources":["../../src/index.ts"],"sourcesContent":["// `?raw` is a Vite-only import: it resolves only when the runner deploys\n// the build output instead of bundling this file from source.\nimport greeting from \"./greeting.txt?raw\";\n\nexport default {\n  async fetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> {\n    const { pathname } = new URL(request.url);\n\n    if (pathname === \"/api/greeting\") {\n      return Response.json({ greeting: greeting.trim() });\n    }\n\n    if (pathname === \"/api/phase1-boom\") {\n      throw new Error(\"phase1-boom-testtoken\");\n    }\n\n    return new Response(\"not found\", { status: 404 });\n  },\n};\n"],"mappings":";;;;A,6BAKE,MAAM,MAAM,SAAqC;CAC/C,MAAM,EAAE,aAAa,IAAI,IAAI,QAAQ,GAAG;CAExC,IAAI,aAAa,iBACf,OAAO,SAAS,KAAK,EAAE,UAAUA,iBAAS,KAAK,EAAE,CAAC;CAGpD,IAAI,aAAa,oBACf,MAAM,IAAI,MAAM,uBAAuB;CAGzC,OAAO,IAAI,SAAS,aAAa,EAAE,QAAQ,IAAI,CAAC;AAClD,E"}
